name: At what stage of an interior remodel is drywall installed?

mainEntity.name: At what stage of an interior remodel is drywall installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall work occurs right after rough framing, electrical wiring, and plumbing rough-ins are inspected and approved. Hanging and finishing drywall must happen before any finish carpentry, interior door installation, baseboards, or final interior painting can begin. Getting the taping, mudding, and sanding completely finished first keeps construction dust off finished trim and prevents newly painted surfaces from getting soiled or scuffed. Because our crew handles both custom framing and drywall directly, transitions between structural prep and wall surfacing move seamlessly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall is hung and finished immediately after rough plumbing and electrical are completed, and before installing interior doors, trim, moldings, or final paint.
